title: Arabic RAG — Historical Document Retrieval
summary: Arabic retrieval pipeline that finds the most relevant context in historical documents.

details.Problem: Retrieve relevant source passages for Arabic questions over historical documents.
details.Pipeline: LangChain, Hugging Face embeddings, ChromaDB, and indexed source metadata.
details.Chunking: Parent-Child chunking to balance precise matching with full document context.
details.Retrieval: Explored Dense, BM25, and weighted Hybrid retrieval.
details.Evaluation: Retrieval experiments with Arabic questions and reference source pages to compare search strategies.

title: AI Ticket Classifier — LLM-Based Support Ticket Classification
summary: LLM system that classifies support tickets and writes concise ticket summaries.

details.Problem: Classify support tickets by category, sentiment, and urgency, and generate concise summaries.
details.Approach: Few-shot prompt engineering with schema-constrained JSON generation.
details.Evaluation: Framework measuring classification accuracy, structured-output validity, and overall success rate.

title: Heart Disease Prediction
summary: End-to-end ML pipeline to predict heart disease from 630K clinical records.

details.Problem: Early detection of heart disease risk using patient health indicators.
details.Feature Engineering: EDA, feature engineering, and Isolation Forest outlier detection.
details.Models: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, with cross-validation and threshold tuning.
details.Results: Best XGBoost: 92.65% test accuracy, 0.9847 ROC-AUC, 91.84% F1-score.

title: Airline Delay Cause Prediction (DNN)
summary: Deep Neural Network that classifies airline delay causes from 318K+ records.

details.Problem: Multi-class classification of airline delay causes.
details.Pipeline: Data cleaning, feature engineering, train-test splitting, model training.

title: Breast Cancer Classification
summary: ML classification pipeline to classify breast tumors as malignant or benign.

details.Problem: Classify breast tumors as malignant or benign to support diagnosis.
details.Models: SVM kernels, Decision Tree with GridSearchCV, KNN.
details.Results: Best models: 98.25% test accuracy, mean 5-fold CV accuracy of 96.92%.

title: Customer Churn Prediction
summary: Predictive modeling to identify at-risk customers and improve retention strategies.

details.Problem: Classify telecom customers likely to cancel service to enable proactive retention.
details.Feature Engineering: One-hot encoding, tenure binning, scaling numerical features.
details.Results: Achieved 0.82 ROC-AUC with 78% Recall on churn class.

title: Weather Forecasting
summary: Time-series forecasting model to predict daily temperature and rainfall.

details.Problem: Forecast next-day weather conditions using historical climate data.
details.Feature Engineering: Lag features, rolling windows, seasonal decomposition.
details.Results: RMSE of 2.1°C on test set forecasts.

title: House Price Prediction
summary: Regression model to estimate property values based on features and location.

details.Problem: Predict continuous sale prices from multi-modal housing data.
details.Feature Engineering: Handling missing values, log-transforming target, label encoding.
details.Results: R2 Score of 0.89; Top 15% on leaderboard benchmarks.
